title: {{NAME}} and the Fairy Princess Who Could Not Shine
moral: You do not need to be perfect to be wonderful.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked through the glittering fairy kingdom. Tiny castles sat inside big flowers. Sparkling streams ran between the petals. A princess fairy sat on a pink mushroom alone. She was the only fairy whose wings did not glow.

pages.content: The fairy princess was called Glow. But Glow's wings had never glowed. All the other fairies shone bright. Glow thought something was wrong with her. She hid her wings under her cape.

pages.content: {{NAME}} watched the other fairies. They glowed when they did something kind. He had an idea. He asked Glow to help him reach a flower that had fallen over. Glow flew down and lifted it up.

pages.content: Glow's wings lit up. Just a little at first. Then brighter and brighter. Glow looked back at her wings. Her eyes went wide. She had not known she could shine like this!

pages.content: Glow glowed the brightest of all when she was kind. She flew and helped all day. You do not need to be perfect to be wonderful. Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Sleep well. Glow whispered that she had found a door in the oldest flower in the kingdom. What could be through it?
